title: KaleidoscopeOS Android 13 on Redmi K50i Clean Flash Setup
blurb: KaleidoscopeOS Edition on Android 13 for the Redmi K50i — November patch, parallel space, and a fix for the auto-brightness that never behaved.
video_description:
KaleidoscopeOS Edition on Android 13 for the Redmi K50i — November patch, parallel space, and a fix for the auto-brightness that never behaved.

KaleidoscopeOS keeps its AOSP base close to stock and then adds the parts people actually notice: a second space for work apps, smoother display handling, and a brightness curve that isn't fighting you. On the K50i it settles in quickly, but this build wants a clean flash. Dirty flashing over an older base is exactly where the strange little bugs come from.

📱 Device  : Redmi K50i
🧩 ROM     : KaleidoscopeOS Edition
🤖 Android : 13

🗒️ What's In This Build
• November security patch merged
• Parallel space added
• Smooth display added
• Auto-brightness fixed
• Other fixes and improvements

🛠️ How To Flash It
1. Back up everything first — this one asks for a clean flash.
2. Reboot into recovery.
3. Format data before installing, no shortcuts here.
4. Flash the ROM package and let it run to the end.
5. Reboot and set the phone up from scratch.

⚠️ Where People Get Stuck
• Dirty flashing over an older build and then blaming the ROM for the mess.
• Skipping the data format. This build asks for it.
• Forgetting that SELinux is permissive here, which some banking apps don't like.
